**Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.** is a prominent leader in the global specialty chemicals industry, specializing in the research, development, production, and distribution of high-performance silicone-based materials and textile auxiliaries. Headquartered at **No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China**, the company has strategically positioned itself at the heart of one of China’s most dynamic economic and technological hubs. Since its inception, Runhe Chemical has grown from a specialized manufacturer into a publicly traded powerhouse (Stock Code: 300727.SZ), recognized as a "National High-Tech Enterprise" for its contributions to material science.

The company’s product portfolio is remarkably diverse, catering to a wide range of industrial applications. Its core expertise lies in two major sectors: **Specialty Silicone Materials** and **Textile Chemicals**. The silicone division focuses on innovative products such as silicone surfactants, agricultural silicone synergists, silane coupling agents, and specialty silicone oils. These materials are essential in industries ranging from personal care and cosmetics to energy and agriculture. In the textile sector, Runhe is a market leader in providing softening agents, block silicone oils, and finishing auxiliaries that enhance the texture, durability, and functionality of fabrics.

At the core of Runhe Chemical’s success is its unwavering commitment to **Research and Development (R&D)**. The company operates state-of-the-art laboratories and maintains a robust team of scientists and engineers dedicated to "green chemistry" and sustainable innovation. By focusing on eco-friendly production methods and high-efficiency formulations, Runhe helps its global partners reduce their environmental footprint while improving product performance.

With a comprehensive sales network that spans across China and reaches international markets in Southeast Asia, Europe, and the Americas, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. has built a reputation for reliability, quality, and customer-centric service. From its prestigious Hangzhou headquarters on Qingchun Road, the company continues to drive the industry forward, aiming to become a world-class supplier of new chemical materials that empower modern industry and improve daily life through science.
